title: npm audit-gate exceptions
description: Expiring, per-advisory exceptions for scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Every entry MUST name the exact GHSA id it covers and carry a reviewBy date; once that date passes, audit-gate.mjs treats the advisory as blocking again regardless of this file.

id.description: Exact GitHub Security Advisory id this exception covers. Matched by equality against the advisory url npm audit --json reports — never a package name or a range.

package.description: The package the advisory is published against (for humans reviewing this file; audit-gate.mjs matches on id, not this field).

reason.description: Why this advisory cannot be fixed by upgrading right now, with the evidence cited (e.g. first_patched_version: null).

reviewBy.description: Once today's date passes this, audit-gate.mjs stops honoring the exception and the advisory fails the gate again until this file is updated.
